items.q: Wilbur De Paris played with some orchestra in the Sterling Hotel, so I never heard him.

ctx.x: Wilbur De Paris played with some orchestra in the Sterling Hotel, so I never heard him. Sidney didn't remember me going to the same school as he, but I did remember my cousin Theophilus Chenault and I became better acquainted with Sidney De Paris after I told him that Theophilus was my cousin.

I never heard the De Paris family play together but I was told that the mother, father and a sister of Sidney all played music. I don't know if there were more than one sister but there was only the two boys, Wilbur and Sidney.
Those medicine shows usually stayed in a city one or two months and then moved on to another city. When they left Cincinnati, the De Paris family left also and I never saw Sidney in Cincy again.
